problem: `--without <component>` is accepted whenever the profile declares the component, even when excluding it cannot change the plan. Profile `full` lists every module unconditionally, so all 23 `--without <component>` ids are accepted, exit 0 and install the same 56 modules; the dry-run prints `✗ framework:react — explicitly excluded via --without` while listing react-review-skills, react-rules and react-skills. Same for react/nestjs/vue/angular/nextjs-nuxt `--without lang:ts-js-node`, nextjs-nuxt `--without framework:vue`, django/fastapi `--without lang:python`: 31 accepted no-op `--without` ids across 25 profiles.
impact: The silent-success case AC2 targets; the user is told a component was excluded and its files are installed anyway. The refusal's 'valid --without ids' list advertises these no-op ids.
suggested_fix: After selection and the --without filter, refuse any --without component none of whose modules left the selection, with the 'cannot change the plan' error; build the valid list from removable components only. Add a fixture where a declared component's module is also in profile.modules.
evidence: verified — scratchpad/r365/noop-without.ts over every (profile, flag, id) through planInstall: 'no-op --without=31'; CLI probe one.ts `--profile full --target claude --without framework:react --dry-run` exits 0 with the ✗ line and all react-* modules.
